## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmed by strong overall sector breadth but narrow leadership (Top 5: Narrow (4/5 Technology)), producing conflicting signals that justify CAUTION. Watch major short-vs-mid-term divergences among big caps as a second confirmation.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND. Materials and Industrials follow: NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy is weak: XOM (1W: -1.54% | 1M: +11.33%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION. Utilities/Real Estate also lag: SRE (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND and VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: VLO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +6.48%) CORRECTION, F (1W: -4.77% | 1M: +2.72%) CORRECTION, MAR (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Energy and Utilities; reduce exposure to names showing BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND. MAJOR Divergence present (multiple large caps with 1W↑ / 1M↓) — watch for trend break and treat rallies as tactical opportunities, not core-confirmations.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech shows short-term strength but mixed signals: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY. Sector-level 1W strength (Tech 1W: +9.24% | 1M: +5.08%) versus multiple RECOVERY names suggests rotation within tech.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials steady with selective strength: JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND while payment names show exhaustion — V (1W: -0.99% | 1M: +4.11%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +7.60%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth positive (Financials 1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.91%); favor selective exposure to confirmed ABOVE TREND names.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare internally mixed: JNJ (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +0.05%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.77% | 1M: -5.70%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth modestly positive (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +3.44%); watch earnings-driven flows.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to Financials and Materials leaders (JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor Technology rallies for confirmation. Reduce exposure to Energy/Utilities names showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND and be cautious with single-name tech where 1M remains negative; style mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CVS (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%) BELOW TREND, SRE (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -9.38% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +5.08%) and Materials (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +6.99%) given momentum. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.43% | 1M: +5.54%) and Utilities (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -3.24%) remain at risk of further underperformance.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch for NVDA to sustain ABOVE TREND and clear last-week highs for confirmation of tech follow-through; failure would favor profit-taking. Monitor AAPL (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY for reversion above its 1M trend and JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND for financial leadership continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
CAT (+80): Headline cites record quarter and raised outlook; CAT (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%) RECOVERY — news confirms the 1W bounce but 1M remains negative, so watch for follow-through. MPC (+65): Refining earnings surge; MPC (1W: -5.77% | 1M: +5.26%) CORRECTION — positive news but short-term weakness, monitor for mean-reversion.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (-80): Credit concerns headline but ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines diverge from price, signalling possible distribution. BA (-50): FAA inspection headlines; BA (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +5.07%) ABOVE TREND — negative news while price rallies, watch for volatility.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech-heavy top performers despite broad sector breadth. MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND are showing short-term strength. Key risk is MAJOR divergence across large caps (several 1W↑ / 1M↓) and headline-price divergences (e.g., ORCL) — watch for trend breaks.
